rows.name: caption/Content · dynamic-pages
rows.text: Set here, generated on publish. There is no TEMPLATE PAGE control on this screen — pageTemplatePath is read once, to decide a warning, and ContentViews.tsx:630 says "Nothing in this panel sets it". The “Generates N pages” count reads LOCAL records while generation reads SERVER entries (:623 vs cms.service.ts:198-202), so a queued sync overstates it. Nothing outside this panel knows these pages exist.
rows.why: QA-A-11 + QA-A-13 + UX-C-19 — commentary moved out of the 280px panel into the section's caption channel.

rows.name: caption/Content · collection-setup (modal)
rows.text: One of THREE screens that create a collection, and they disagree on what one is: five field types here (CMSCollectionSetupModal.tsx:47) against nine plus a required flag on the Fields screen (ContentViews.tsx:440), against a fixed eight-field Products schema in the e-commerce dialog — the only path that sets a display field. So the Slug field this wizard's own /{slug} default depends on cannot be created here. Step 1's Content type is read by nothing (:112 declared, :326 rendered, never read by handleCreate at :168-227); the field row's drag handle has no drag handlers (:378); Create is enabled on the name alone, and a duplicate name is never checked. This is also the only screen that can ever set a template page.
rows.why: UX-C-20, UX-C-22, UX-C-11, UX-C-09 — the modal had no caption at all.

rows.name: caption/Content · records (modal)
rows.text: The SECOND record editor, reachable only from ⌘⇧P. Delete asks nothing here (CMSRecordsModal.tsx:168) while the panel confirms; neither view can be searched, filtered or paged; there is no record import or export anywhere (:426-432).
rows.why: UX-C-07, UX-C-23, UX-C-28 — the modal had no caption at all.

rows.name: caption/Content · record · save-error
rows.text: Every retry leaves a draft behind. Saving with Published on creates the record as a draft FIRST and then flips its status, and only that second call validates (useContentPanel.ts:161-168, CollectionManager.ts:301-307); the form catches the error, marks the fields and still thinks it is composing a NEW record. Three fumbles, three hidden drafts.
rows.why: UX-C-08 (Critical) — the board that draws this state carried no caption.
